nom: ANUA KPop Demon Hunters Invisible Glow Finish Sunscreen Stick

avis.texte: I've been wanting to try a stick sunscreen, this is so easy to use. Feels really nice too even on top of makeup, not greasy or sticky at all. Has no scent which i love and it did not break me out, seems like it will last a while.

Any time i wear this and step into the sun my face turns TOMATO red, my face was actually only red in the spots i applied the stick so i know its what caused it. Kinda scared me because didnt seem too good for my skin.
Do not recommend. This leaves your face so greasy ALL day long even without reapplying. It is easy to apply and i liked that it was clear but this is a hard no.
The stick looks pretty but we alm brned very quickly. Inffective.
Unfortunately I really wanted to love it but it made my face super red. I already have rosecea and sensitve skin combined. Do not recommend if you have either.

If you are looking for an spf stick for your face this is it. If you are sweaty in the beach you feel the need to reapply your spf on your face or body this is the one! I love the beach. What I don't love is reapply a liquid sunscreen and I definitely don't want to inhale a spray sunscreen. I have never gotten a sunburn while using this product and it is so easy to apply. Also the expiration date is at least 12 to 18 months when purchased so I end up using all of it instead of having to repurchase and throw out part of the product because it expired to quick.. I have a hobby farm and I spend a lot of time outside so I use a good amount of sunscreen daily and this last me several months.. If you google the best SPF sticks and you see all those nice name brand ones..this one is better! If you are super sensitive and have a ton of acne it may not work for you but for the rest of the world I'd have to say give it a try! I have rosacea and this doesn't irritate me at all. I have a kid with mild acne and he tolerates this with no irritation.
I liked this for the 50 spf but wow its slippery and greasy. It just slides everywhere. Feels like you put oil on your face….and i have dry skin. Was awful.

avis.titre: Like it but can't keep using it
avis.texte: Definitely loved it at first because it pairs great with my shiny skin routine. It leaves my face still shiny. But I just realized it makes the sweat on my forehead and face pool and just sent so my face gets drenched when I'm outside. I live in humid weather so even when it's cool outside I'm still drenched. Great product but doesn't work for a person that sweats.

I wouldnt use it on my face. I have acne, oily prone skin. This formula feels tacky on your skin and doesnt fully sink in. I do use it on my body so it doesnt go to waste and it does deliver on a little glow. Nice if your going to the beach or during the summer. My container broke at the bottom. I had to super glue it back together. The box had the deepy tiger, the actual sunscreen container doesnt. Overall, nice to try but would no buy again.
This sunscreen is so nice. It glides on smoothly, no white cast, skin looks dewy. Makeup remains untouched. My daughter loves it as well! Will definitely keep purchasing.

Would it have really been so hard to put the k-pop demon hunter art on the actual item and not the box? I bought this for my kid because she loves the movie and I wanted her to have an on the go sunblock but we were disappointed when we opened it AND she did experience some forehead acne afterwards. I tried it myself and it felt like it was trapping everything under it on my skin. Hard to explain but it was not a great feeling. We will go back to Shisheido's sun stick instead.

I have been looking for an SPF that is safe for my allergies and friendly to my sensitive skin. This SPF dries quickly when applied properly has a sheer finish and ingredients that have improved my skin texture as well as hydration. I cannot recommend this product enough and I love that it's fragrance free.

I have been looking for an SPF that has ingredients that are friendly for my allergid and sensitive skin, this couldn't be better. It dries quickly when used correctly and has improved my skin's hydration and texture. I love that it is fragrance free as well.
Love how smooth and easy it is to apply this sunscreen. Especially like the fact that I don't have to use my hands and fingers
I wanted to love this so bad. It made me have mini bumps everywhere on my skin, and it made me feel greasy. ( i have normal to combo skin)

I absolutely love this spf stick. Most sunscreens burn my eyes but that did nlt happen with this one, and it made my face feel hydrated while not looking greasy. This sunscreen stick layers well ontop of skin care or under makeup and its cute and compact so its easy to carry around, I would definitley reccomend it.
